title: MouseMoveParams
description: Move the pointer along a humanised trajectory (`tool.mouse_move`).

duration_ms.description: Approximate wall-clock duration of the move. Defaults to an adaptive value between 350–950 ms based on travel distance.

from_x.description: Start X. Both `from_*` fields must be given together; when omitted the trajectory starts at the pointer's last known position on the tab, or the viewport centre if none is recorded.

jitter.description: Add ±0.5 px per-point noise. Defaults to `true`.

overshoot.description: Overshoot the destination by 2–8% of the travel distance and glide back. Defaults to a random ~12% chance.

steps.description: Number of dispatched move points (including the destination). Defaults to `duration_ms / 12` clamped to 12–80.

tab_id.description: Target tab. Defaults to the Agent Window's active tab.

to_x.description: Destination X in top-level viewport CSS pixels.

to_y.description: Destination Y in top-level viewport CSS pixels.

MouseCurve.description: Path shape for a humanised mouse move (`tool.mouse_move`, or the `glide` option of `tool.hover` / `tool.click`).

oneOf.description: Cubic Bézier through two random control points offset perpendicular to the start–end line (default).
Straight line between start and end.
